podcast.title: Formation and Influence (1986-1994)
podcast.body: Formed in Louisville, Kentucky, in 1986, Slint spent eight years laying key foundations for the entire post-rock approach to sound-making and is considered legendary in this musical world. "Slint was formed in 1986, and over eight years laid some of the key foundations of the whole post-rock approach to soundmaking."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Band's Humorous Side
podcast.body: Despite the aura of mystery and darkness that formed around Slint's public image, the band members reportedly spent their days playing jokes on each other and did not hesitate to tease prominent musicians like David Yow of The Jesus Lizard or engineer Astifal Vinny. An anecdote tells of them approaching Vinny's door to propose recording their album, playfully armed with "Carlson Cillos" and pointing drinks directly at his face. "Pese a la hora de misterio y oscuridad que se formó en torno a su figura, se pasaban el día que en dobromas entre ellos y no se cortaban en vacilar a músicos de la talla de David Joe, de Gisos Liza o Astifal-Vini."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Billy Corgan's Admiration
podcast.body: Billy Corgan of The Smashing Pumpkins highly admired Slint; he gushed about them for almost 15 minutes in a conversation, and considered being in a band with a Slint member "a dream come true." "In fact, when Billy Corrigan broke up the smashing pumpkins, he recruited Slint guitarist David Peio for this short-lived band called Zwan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Childhood Bands and Influences
podcast.body: Britt Walford and Brian McMahan formed their first hardcore punk band, Lanky-Tan-Flas-It, when they were only 11 years old, so small that their parents had to carry their equipment. By age 14, they were part of Squirrel Bait, described as a seminal hardcore band that influenced the sound of "mocor" (grunge). These early musicians, with their nerdy appearance, literally grew up alongside and rubbed shoulders with bands like Hüsker Dü, Black Flag, and Big Black. "Brit-Wallford y Brian Magmahan formaron su primera banda de hardcore punk, Lanky-Tan-Flas-It, cuando tenían tal sólo 11 años. Era el tan pequeño que sus padres tenían que cargar con el equipo. Con 14 formaron parte de Squire-El-Bate, la seminal de hardcore y el sonido de mocor."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Critical Acclaim from Steve Albini
podcast.body: The first review for *Spiderland* came from Steve Albini for the British publication *Melody Maker*. He awarded the album a score of "10 damn stars," describing it as "unsettling, sinister, and beautiful." "La primera reseña del disco vino de la mano de Steve Albini para el medio británico Melody Maker, dijo de él, y le dio una puntuación de 10 jodidas estrellas."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Formation and Early Hardcore Experience
podcast.body: Slint formed in Louisville, Kentucky, in 1986. At the time of their formation, the members were around 16 years old. Despite their youth, they were not novices, having already spent several years participating in the American hardcore punk scene. "Es lind se formaron en Luisville, Kentucky en 1986. La banda estaba formada por el guitarrista de la vocalista Brian Magmahan, el batería Brit-Wallford, el guitarrista David Pajoy y el bajista Ethan Buckler. En el momento de formar la banda, los miembros rondaban los 16 años, pero no eran unos novatos, llevaban ya varias años formando parte de la escena hardcore punk americana."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Iconic Album Artwork
podcast.body: Joe Aldam, a friend of the band, took several photographs of the group to be considered for potential album covers. From these sessions emerged the striking, evocative black-and-white cover of *Spiderland*, which perfectly captures the mysterious aura that envelops the record. "De esas sesiones surge la llamítica portada, la cual captura se aura de misterio que envuelve el disco."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Influence on The Smashing Pumpkins
podcast.body: Slint's sound had an obvious influence on The Smashing Pumpkins, evident when playing songs from both bands back-to-back. "We heard how slint influenced the smashing pumpkins, and that influence is pretty obvious when you play songs from both bands back to back."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Lasting Influence and Legacy
podcast.body: Over the years, *Spiderland* sold an increasing number of copies and significantly influenced many subsequent bands. Slint is often described as "the Velvet Underground of the 90s" in terms of their profound influence. While their sound wasn't purely post-rock, it marked the entire scene, with bands like Tortoise and Mogwai declaring that without *Spiderland*, everything would have been very different. It also influenced other styles such as Math Rock and "Pro de Sifemo" (Progressive Math). "Con los años, el disco fue vendiendo cada vez más copias, influyendo a muchas bandas que vendían detrás. Se podría decir de Slin, que son la velvetander round de los 90 en cuanto a influencia."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Post-Spiderland Breakup
podcast.body: Slint separated almost immediately after the recording of *Spiderland*. The morning after completing the recording, Brian McMahan was admitted to a hospital where he was diagnosed with depression. He subsequently left the band, a life-changing decision he attributed to the disorientation of a mind overwhelmed by anxiety. "Sin embargo, prácticamente el día después de la grabación, la banda se separará."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes

podcast.title: Recommended Post-Rock Band
podcast.body: The band is explicitly listed as a recommendation for those wanting to explore post-rock further. "If you want to go deeper, look into bands like Talk Talk, Slint, Barxide Coses, Tortoise, Magwai, Stereolab, Godspeed you, Black Amper, we always keep coming back to them."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Rigorous Rehearsal Practices
podcast.body: After the release of their first album and with band members attending university, they would periodically return to Louisville to practice and write new material. During these sessions, held in the Walford family basement, they could spend up to nine hours rehearsing a single riff. Over three years, they meticulously polished their sound, incorporating complex time signature changes and dark textures, progressively distancing themselves from hardcore. "En esas sesiones, se podrían pasar nueve horas ensayando al mismo riff, ensayaban en el sótano de los Walford."

srcs.episode: Spiderland: La Revolución del Rock Hecha por Adolescentes
